name: tnsaints-worker
description: Registration API for Tennessee Saints Basketball Academy evaluations

scripts.db:dump:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="SELECT * FROM registrations ORDER BY id"
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="DELETE FROM registrations; DELETE FROM email_budget;"
scripts.test:local: npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_acceptance.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_cancellation.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_concurrency.py && npm run db:reset:local
